s01.en: It is so great to hear that you, international students, have arrived at our university.
s01.zh: 很高兴得知各位留学生已经抵达我们大学。

s01.en: This notice/announcement is for the purpose of inviting you to attend a welcome party.
s01.zh: 本通知旨在邀请你们参加欢迎会。

s01.en: To begin with, the party is scheduled to start at 19:00 on June 20 in the Center of Students’ Activities and last for approximately two hours.
s01.zh: 首先，欢迎会定于 6 月 20 日 19:00 在学生活动中心开始，持续约两小时。

s01.en: In addition, this party is characterized by a variety of interesting activities, including singing, dancing, Chinese culture introduction, and fun competitions.
s01.zh: 此外，欢迎会包含丰富有趣的活动，包括唱歌、跳舞、介绍中国文化和趣味比赛。

s01.en: Of course, some traditional Chinese snacks will be served at the party.
s01.zh: 当然，会上还将提供一些中国传统小吃。

s01.en: To conclude, it is advisable for you to participate in this party, which will bring you opportunities to make friends, arouse your passion for the campus life, and help you know China better.
s01.zh: 总之，建议你们参加这次欢迎会，它会让你们有机会交朋友，激发对校园生活的热情，并帮助你们更好地了解中国。

s01.en: Finally, we are looking forward to your participation.

s02.en: I am quite pleased to hear that you are looking for AI tools to promote learning efficiency.
s02.zh: 很高兴得知你正在寻找提高学习效率的 AI 工具。

s02.en: Today, I am writing to make a recommendation.
s02.zh: 今天我写信来是想推荐一下。

s02.en: It is advisable for you to try out several AI tools in learning since it is by trying them out that you can know which one can best suit your needs.
s02.zh: 建议你在学习中试用几种 AI 工具，因为只有通过试用，才能知道哪种最适合你的需求。

s02.en: A case in point is myself.
As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I tried ERNIE Bot, Tongyi, and Kimi.
s02.zh: 作为一名正在准备全国研究生入学考试的大四学生，我试过文心一言、通义和 Kimi。

s02.en: In the end, I chose Kimi, which is characterized by its excellent performance in information collection.
s02.zh: 最终我选择了 Kimi，它的特点是在信息搜集方面表现出色。

s02.en: This AI tool can bring me high efficiency, inspire my passion for learning, and help me save time and energy.
s02.zh: 这个 AI 工具能提高我的效率，激发我的学习热情，并帮我节省时间和精力。

s02.en: I am looking forward to discussing more details of the AI tools after you use them.
s02.zh: 等你使用之后，我期待与你讨论 AI 工具的更多细节。

s03.en: I’m quite pleased to know that you are interested in the peer mentoring program for new students.
s03.zh: 得知你对面向新生的同伴指导项目感兴趣，我十分高兴。

s03.en: Today, I am writing for the purpose of introducing certain details.
s03.zh: 今天我写信是想介绍一些相关细节。

s03.en: This program pairs freshmen with seniors to help them adapt to college life.
s03.zh: 该项目让新生与高年级学生结对，帮助他们适应大学生活。

s03.en: To begin with, college life is characterized by the fact that students have more spare time.
s03.zh: 首先，大学生活的特点之一是学生有更多空闲时间。

s03.en: Then, compared with high schools, there are a wider variety of campus activities, clubs and organizations in college.
s03.zh: 其次，与高中相比，大学里有更加丰富多样的校园活动、社团和组织。

s03.en: Thus we, as senior students, are supposed to help you develop a new pace of study and life suited for college.
s03.zh: 因此，作为高年级学生，我们应该帮助你们形成适合大学的新学习和生活节奏。

s03.en: To conclude, it’s advisable for you to sign up for the peer mentoring program.
s03.zh: 总之，建议你报名参加同伴指导项目。

s03.en: I’m convinced that you will benefit a lot from it.
s03.zh: 我相信你会从中获益良多。

s03.en: Of course, if you have any other questions, please feel free to ask me.
s03.zh: 当然，如果还有其他问题，随时可以问我。

s04.en: I am quite pleased to recall the summer when I attended the study abroad program in your country.
s04.zh: 回想起在贵国参加留学项目的那个夏天，我非常高兴。

s04.en: Today, I am writing for the purpose of extending my gratitude and inviting you to visit China.
s04.zh: 今天写信是为了表达感谢，并邀请您来中国旅行。

s04.en: To begin with, it was your tremendous help that enabled me to enjoy a comfortable and fruitful trip of learning.
s04.zh: 首先，正是您的鼎力相助，使我拥有一段舒适而收获丰富的学习之旅。

s04.en: Thus, I am deeply grateful to you for your help.
s04.zh: 因此，我非常感谢您的帮助。

s04.en: In addition, I know that you are fond of China’s ancient architecture.
s04.zh: 此外，我知道您喜欢中国古代建筑。

s04.en: Accordingly, I deem that it is advisable for you to visit in person the Great Wall, the Summer Palace, the Forbidden City and so on in your spare time.
s04.zh: 因此，我认为您可以在闲暇时亲自游览长城、颐和园和故宫等地。

s04.en: I am looking forward to your favorable reply at your earliest convenience so that I can repay you.
s04.zh: 期待早日收到您的肯定答复，好让我报答您。

s05.en: So glad to hear that you are going to participate in a speech contest on Chinese culture.
s05.zh: 很高兴得知你将参加关于中国文化的演讲比赛。

s05.en: I am writing to suggest a topic.
s05.zh: 我写信是想推荐一个主题。

s05.en: To begin with, it is advisable for you to choose China’s ancient architecture as your topic since China is characterized by its time-honored history and I know that you are fond of China’s ancient buildings.
s05.zh: 首先，建议你选择中国古代建筑作为主题，因为中国历史悠久，而且我知道你喜欢中国古建筑。

s05.en: In addition, you are supposed to visit the Great Wall, the Summer Palace, and the Forbidden City, which will bring you distinctive experience, arouse your passion for Chinese culture, and help you prepare fully for the contest.
s05.zh: 此外，你可以参观长城、颐和园和故宫，这会带给你独特的体验，唤起你对中国文化的热情，并帮助你为比赛做好充分准备。

s05.en: Finally, if you have any other questions, please call me and I will be available every Friday morning.
s05.zh: 最后，如果还有其他问题，请给我打电话，我每周五上午都有空。

s06.en: I am quite pleased to hear that you are coming to China and I originally planned to pick you up at the airport.
s06.zh: 很高兴得知你将来中国，我原本计划去机场接你。

s06.en: However, I am writing for the purpose of making an apology since I am afraid I can’t make it.
s06.zh: 但是我写信是想道歉，因为恐怕我去不了了。

s06.en: You know that during the past half year, I have been exceedingly busy because I allocated nearly all my time and energy for preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, which is of great significance to me.
s06.zh: 你知道过去半年我特别忙，因为我几乎把所有时间和精力都用来准备对我意义重大的全国研究生入学考试。

s06.en: Then, due to my carelessness, I did not notice that the date of the test is the day when you will arrive in China until two minutes ago.
s06.zh: 而且由于我的粗心，直到两分钟前我才发现考试当天就是你抵达中国的日子。

s06.en: Accordingly, I have no option but to ask my best friend, Sky, to pick you up at the airport this Saturday.
s06.zh: 因此，我只好请我最好的朋友斯凯本周六去机场接你。

s06.en: I am deeply sorry and I plan to show you around Beijing after the test.
s06.zh: 我非常抱歉，打算考试后带你游览北京。

s07.en: As a senior student at Peking University who is quite interested in cultural communication, I am writing for the purpose of applying for the volunteer position at your center.
s07.zh: 作为北京大学一名对文化交流很感兴趣的大四学生，我写信申请贵中心的志愿者岗位。

s07.en: I am convinced that I am qualified for this position for two reasons.
s07.zh: 我坚信自己能够胜任这一岗位，原因有二。

s07.en: To begin with, during my college years, I have devoted nearly all my time and energy to my major, Cross-cultural Exchange.
s07.zh: 首先，在大学期间，我几乎把所有时间和精力都投入到跨文化交流这一专业中。

s07.en: It was my hard work that enabled me to accumulate adequate professional knowledge and skills.
s07.zh: 正是我的努力使我积累了足够的专业知识和技能。

s07.en: In addition, compared with others, I possess richer experience in communicating with foreigners, since I have served as a volunteer for several international conferences.
s07.zh: 此外，与其他人相比，我与外国人交流的经验更丰富，因为我曾担任多场国际会议的志愿者。

s07.en: If I am lucky enough to be a volunteer for your center, I will do my utmost to fulfill my duties.
s07.zh: 如果有幸成为贵中心的志愿者，我将尽最大努力履行职责。

s08.en: So excited to recall the one-day career exploration program organized by you.
s08.zh: 回想起您组织的一日职业探索项目，我十分激动。

s08.en: Today, I am writing to express my thanks and make one suggestion.
s08.zh: 今天我写信是为了表达感谢并提出一条建议。

s08.en: This program did help us broaden our horizons, inspire our passion for exploring future career paths, and provide us with an opportunity to put theoretical knowledge into practice.
s08.zh: 该项目确实帮助我们开阔视野，激发探索未来职业道路的热情，并为我们提供了将理论知识付诸实践的机会。

s08.en: Thus, we are quite grateful to you for your excellent organization.
s08.zh: 因此，我们非常感谢您出色的组织工作。

s08.en: However, compared with students’practical requirements, the duration and depth of the program were not sufficient.
s08.zh: 但是，相比学生的实际需求，项目的时长和深度仍有不足。

s08.en: Therefore, it is advisable for our university’s Career Center to organize more programs lasting two days or longer to further our career exploration.
s08.zh: 因此，建议我校就业指导中心组织更多为期两天或更长的项目，以进一步促进职业探索。

s08.en: Finally, I am convinced that with your support, students will benefit more from future programs.
s08.zh: 最后，我相信在您的支持下，学生将从未来的项目中获得更多益处。

s09.en: I am deeply sorry to hear that you did not do well in your recent maths midterm exam.
s09.zh: 听说你最近的数学期中考试没考好，我很难过。

s09.en: Today, I am writing for the purpose of sharing my suggestions and encouraging you.
s09.zh: 今天写信是想分享我的建议并鼓励你。

s09.en: To begin with, it is advisable for you to prepare in advance since it is full preparation that enables you to accumulate adequate knowledge and skills for the test.
s09.zh: 首先，建议你提前准备，因为正是充分的准备才能让你积累足够的考试知识和技能。

s09.en: A case in point is myself.
Compared with others, I am not smarter, but full preparation can bring me confidence, arouse my passion for learning, and help me succeed in maths tests.
s09.zh: 与其他人相比，我并不更聪明，但充分准备能带给我自信，激发学习热情，帮助我在数学考试中取得成功。

s09.en: In addition, it is of great necessity for you to summarize your errors as success derives from failure.
s09.zh: 此外，你很有必要总结错误，因为成功源于失败。

s09.en: To conclude, I am convinced that if you do your utmost to prepare and practice in advance, you will do better in the next exam.
s09.zh: 总之，我相信，如果你尽最大努力提前准备和练习，下次考试会取得更好的成绩。

s10.en: This meeting was for the purpose of discussing how to prevent food waste in everyday life and finally all participants came to the same conclusion.
s10.zh: 本次会议旨在讨论如何避免日常生活中的食物浪费，最终所有与会者达成了一致结论。

s10.en: The meeting began at 14:00 on June 20 in Classroom 201 and lasted for two hours.
s10.zh: 会议于 6 月 20 日 14:00 在 201 教室开始，持续了两小时。

s10.en: Professor Sky raised the question and pointed out that compared to the past years, we enjoy a richer life and thus an increasing number of youngsters do not cherish food.
s10.zh: 斯凯教授提出问题并指出，与过去相比，我们的生活更富裕，因此越来越多年轻人不珍惜食物。

s10.en: Then, all classmates agreed that this phenomenon is particularly worth attention.
s10.zh: 接着，所有同学都认为这一现象尤其值得关注。

s10.en: We deemed that it is of great necessity for us to stop wasting not only food, but also time, electricity, water, and the like.
s10.zh: 我们认为，非常有必要停止浪费食物，也要避免浪费时间、电、水等资源。

s10.en: The conclusion is that we are supposed to take immediate actions to prevent food waste in daily life, such as only buying what we need and not throwing away leftovers.
s10.zh: 结论是，我们应该立即采取行动，防止日常生活中的食物浪费，比如只买需要的食物，不扔掉剩饭。

l01.en: This is a table, clearly illustrating the changes in the domestic sales of gasoline-powered and new-energy vehicles in China during the first half of 2025.
l01.zh: 这是一张表格，清晰展示了 2025 年上半年中国国内燃油车与新能源汽车销量的变化。

l01.en: In this period, the sales of new-energy cars increased steadily, from 0.79 million in January to 1.12 million in June.
l01.zh: 在此期间，新能源汽车销量稳步上升，从 1 月的 79 万辆增至 6 月的 112 万辆。

l01.en: By contrast, the sales of gasoline cars fluctuated around 1.1 million.
l01.zh: 相比之下，燃油车销量在 110 万辆左右波动。

l01.en: It is particularly noteworthy that the sales of new-energy vehicles surpassed those of gasoline-powered vehicles in May.
l01.zh: 特别值得注意的是，新能源汽车销量在 5 月超过了燃油车。

l01.en: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the fierce competition between new-energy vehicles and traditional cars.
l01.zh: 这些数据显然与新能源汽车和传统汽车之间的激烈竞争有关。

l01.en: Then, what resulted in the phenomenon above?
l01.zh: 那么，是什么导致了上述现象？

l01.en: For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by its boom and prosperity in economy, which has enabled a host of families to possess additional income to purchase gasoline-powered or new-energy cars.
l01.zh: 一方面，近年来中国经济繁荣发展，这使许多家庭有额外收入购买燃油车或新能源汽车。

l01.en: For another, compared with traditional cars, new-energy vehicles are much cheaper, more eco-friendly, more efficient and require less maintenance.
l01.zh: 另一方面，与传统汽车相比，新能源汽车更便宜、更环保、效率更高，而且所需维护更少。

l01.en: Thus, an increasing number of people have chosen new-energy cars.
l01.zh: 因此，越来越多的人选择新能源汽车。

l01.en: To my understanding, China’s car manufacturers are supposed to pay more attention to the new-energy car market due to its huge potential.
l01.zh: 在我看来，由于新能源汽车市场潜力巨大，中国汽车制造商应该更加关注这一市场。

l01.en: Meanwhile, it is advisable for them to work out comprehensive strategies to develop more types of new-energy vehicles, such as solar-powered cars.
l01.zh: 与此同时，建议他们制定全面策略，开发更多种类的新能源汽车，例如太阳能汽车。

l02.en: Given is a bar chart, which clearly illustrates the striking contrasts in employed residents’ purposes for further study in a certain city in 2025.
l02.zh: 这是一张柱状图，清晰展示了 2025 年某市在职居民继续学习目的之间的显著差异。

l02.en: To be specific, enhancing current job skills ranked first, accounting for 65%.
l02.zh: 具体而言，提升现有工作技能位居第一，占 65%。

l02.en: The next was acquiring knowledge in a new area, at 48%, followed by developing personal interests at 37%.
l02.zh: 其次是获取新领域知识，占 48%；再次是发展个人兴趣，占 37%。

l02.en: Finally came gaining diplomas or vocational certificates, at 26%.
l02.zh: 最后是获得学历或职业证书，占 26%。

l02.en: Such statistics, definitely, can be associated with the growing significance of further study after beginning one’s career.
l02.zh: 这些数据无疑与开始职业生涯后继续学习的重要性日益增加有关。

l02.en: Then, what resulted in this phenomenon?
l02.zh: 那么，是什么导致了这种现象？

l02.en: For one thing, contemporary society is characterized by fierce competition and rapid technological advances, which causes employed people to have no option but to continue learning for the purpose of adapting to job requirements.
l02.zh: 一方面，当代社会竞争激烈，科技进步迅速，这使在职人员为了适应工作要求只能继续学习。

l02.en: A case in point is AI, as it is transforming many fields.
l02.zh: 人工智能就是一个例子，因为它正在改变许多领域。

l02.en: For another, compared to the past, employed people today possess better financial conditions to pursue their interests or make up for deficiencies in educational backgrounds.
l02.zh: 另一方面，与过去相比，现在的在职人员拥有更好的经济条件来追求兴趣或弥补学历背景的不足。

l02.en: In the final analysis, I am convinced that it is advisable for everyone to develop the habit and awareness of lifelong learning, which can give us a competitive edge, inspire our passion for striving, and help us seize opportunities.
l02.zh: 归根结底，我相信每个人都应该培养终身学习的习惯与意识，这能让我们获得竞争优势、激发奋斗热情并帮助我们抓住机会。

l03.en: Given is a column chart, clearly illustrating the striking contrasts in residents’ daily transportation choices in a certain city in 2015 and 2021.
l03.zh: 这是一张柱状图，清晰展示了某市居民在 2015 年和 2021 年日常出行选择的显著差异。

l03.en: In contrast to 2015, the percentages of people who took the bus and who drove private cars decreased in 2021, from approximately 51% and 20% to 27% and 16% respectively.
l03.zh: 与 2015 年相比，2021 年乘公交和驾驶私家车的人所占比例分别从约 51% 和 20% 降至 27% 和 16%。

l03.en: Meanwhile, larger proportions of citizens chose to use online car-hailing or shared bikes, both increasing from less than 10% to nearly 25%.
l03.zh: 与此同时，更多市民选择网约车或共享单车，两者占比都从不足 10% 增至接近 25%。

l03.en: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the diversity of transportation means in contemporary society.
l03.zh: 这些数据显然与当代社会交通方式的多样化有关。

l03.en: Then, what resulted in the phenomenon above?
l03.zh: 那么，是什么导致了上述现象？

l03.en: For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by the rapid development of science and technology, which has enabled a host of companies to develop more types of transportation means.
l03.zh: 一方面，近年来中国科技快速发展，这使许多公司能够开发更多种交通方式。

l03.en: For another, compared to the past years, citizens become richer and more eco-conscious.
l03.zh: 另一方面，与过去相比，市民变得更富裕，也更有环保意识。

l03.en: Thus, many prefer online car-hailing or shared bikes instead of crowded buses.
l03.zh: 因此，许多人更愿意选择网约车或共享单车，而不是拥挤的公交车。

l03.en: Therefore, the government is supposed to provide citizens with safer, more convenient, and more cost-effective modes of transportation.
l03.zh: 因此，政府应为市民提供更安全、更便捷、性价比更高的出行方式。

l03.en: In addition, it is of great necessity to work out comprehensive strategies to enhance public transportation services.
l03.zh: 此外，很有必要制定全面策略，改善公共交通服务。

l04.en: Given is a bar chart, clearly illustrating the remarkable contrasts in students' purposes of utilizing AI in their studies at a certain university.
l04.zh: 这是一张条形图，清晰显示某高校学生使用 AI 学习目的的显著差异。

l04.en: To be specific, searching for and collecting materials ranks first, accounting for 75%.
l04.zh: 具体而言，查询和收集资料位居第一，占 75%。

l04.en: Then, the next is organizing writing ideas, at 67%, followed by translating or revising language, at 60%.
l04.zh: 其次是整理写作思路，占 67%；随后是翻译或修改语言，占 60%。

l04.en: Finally comes interpreting data or concepts, at 50%.
l04.zh: 最后是解释数据或概念，占 50%。

l04.en: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the growing significance of AI in college students' academic pursuits in reality.
l04.zh: 这些数据显然与现实中 AI 在大学生学习中的重要性日益增长有关。

l04.en: Then, what results in this phenomenon?
l04.zh: 那么，是什么导致了这一现象？

l04.en: For one thing, in recent years, AI tools have been characterized by diverse and powerful functions which have encouraged an increasing number of youngsters to use AI in accomplishing various academic assignments.
l04.zh: 一方面，近年来，AI 工具功能多样而强大，鼓励越来越多年轻人用 AI 完成各种学习任务。

l04.en: For another, compared with traditional tools, AI can undoubtedly enhance students' learning efficiency.
l04.zh: 另一方面，与传统工具相比，AI 无疑能够提高学生的学习效率。

l04.en: I am a case in point.
As a youngster who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I prefer using AI to assist me in collecting materials and making plans.
l04.zh: 作为一名正在准备全国研究生入学考试的年轻人，我喜欢用 AI 辅助收集资料和制订计划。

l04.en: In a nutshell, it is AI that enables us to enjoy tremendous convenience.
l04.zh: 简而言之，正是 AI 使我们享受到巨大便利。

l04.en: However, I deem that it is not advisable for us to rely excessively on AI.
l04.zh: 但是，我认为我们不应过度依赖 AI。

l04.en: We are supposed to view it as a collaborative partner rather than a replacement for human thinking.
l04.zh: 我们应把它视为协作伙伴，而不是人类思维的替代品。

l05.en: Given are two charts, clearly illustrating the striking changes in the average lifespan of Chinese people in 2004, 2014 and 2024, as well as the proportion of population aged 60 and above from 2004 to 2024.
l05.zh: 这两张图清晰展示了 2004、2014 和 2024 年中国人均寿命，以及 2004 至 2024 年 60 岁及以上人口比例的显著变化。

l05.en: The left column chart shows that there was a remarkable increase in the average lifespan, from 72.54 to 79.
l05.zh: 左边的柱状图显示，平均寿命显著增长，从 72.54 岁增至 79 岁。

l05.en: Meanwhile, the right line chart displays that the percentage of those aged 60 and above ascended sharply, from 10.97% to 22%.
l05.zh: 同时，右边的折线图显示，60 岁及以上人口比例从 10.97% 急剧升至 22%。

l05.en: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the trend of population aging in China.
l05.zh: 这些数据显然与中国人口老龄化趋势有关。

l05.en: Then, what resulted in the phenomenon above?
l05.zh: 那么，是什么导致了上述现象？

l05.en: For one thing, in recent years, China has been characterized by the economic boom and prosperity, which has enabled a growing number of people to possess additional incomes to enjoy a better quality of life and live longer.
l05.zh: 一方面，近年来中国经济繁荣，使越来越多的人拥有额外收入，享受更高质量的生活并更加长寿。

l05.en: For another, compared to the past years, young people nowadays are more reluctant to marry or give birth owing to various reasons.
l05.zh: 另一方面，与过去相比，如今的年轻人由于各种原因更不愿意结婚或生育。

l05.en: Thus, the proportion of the elderly keeps increasing.
l05.zh: 因此，老年人口比例持续增长。

l05.en: In a nutshell, I deem that it is advisable for the government to focus more on the challenges of population aging, such as the shortage of labor.
l05.zh: 简而言之，我认为政府应更加关注人口老龄化带来的挑战，比如劳动力短缺。

l05.en: In addition, they are supposed to work out comprehensive strategies to encourage more young people to give birth to kids.
l05.zh: 此外，他们应制定全面策略，鼓励更多年轻人生育。

l06.en: Presented is a pie chart, clearly illustrating the striking contrasts in factors that college students at a university take into consideration during their first job hunting in 2025.
l06.zh: 这是一张饼状图，清晰展示了某高校大学生在 2025 年初次求职时考虑的因素之间的显著差异。

l06.en: To be specific, salaries ranked first, accounting for 28%.
l06.zh: 具体来说，薪酬位居第一，占 28%。

l06.en: The next was the opportunity for improvement, at 25%, followed by job duties, at 23%.
l06.zh: 其次是成长机会，占 25%；随后是工作内容，占 23%。

l06.en: Finally came job stability and work locations, at 16% and 8% respectively.
l06.zh: 最后是工作稳定性和工作地点，分别占 16% 和 8%。

l06.en: Such statistics, apparently, can be associated with the significance young people attach to their first jobs in reality.
l06.zh: 这些数据显然与现实中年轻人对第一份工作的重视有关。

l06.en: Then, what resulted in this phenomenon?
l06.zh: 那么，是什么导致了这一现象？

l06.en: To begin with, college graduates are characterized by the fact that they have become adults and need to earn their own bread, which makes them consider the salary as the first factor.
l06.zh: 首先，大学毕业生已经成年，需要自食其力，这使他们把薪酬视为首要因素。

l06.en: In addition, young people are also marked by their strong desire to improve themselves and put what they have learned into practice.
l06.zh: 此外，年轻人也有强烈的自我提升愿望，并渴望将所学付诸实践。

l06.en: Thus, opportunities and job duties are of great importance to them.
l06.zh: 因此，成长机会和工作内容对他们非常重要。

l06.en: As a youngster, I deem that when we hunt for jobs, it is advisable for us to first consider those positions that can provide opportunities to acquire new skills, which definitely can inspire our passion for challenging ourselves, help us enhance our overall competence, and give us better prospects for promotion.
l06.zh: 作为年轻人，我认为求职时应优先考虑提供学习新技能机会的岗位，这无疑能激发挑战自我的热情、提升综合能力，并带来更好的晋升前景。

l07.en: The left drawing shows a simple but quite warm scene, in which there is a disabled person, using a wheelchair to move easily along an accessible pathway.
l07.zh: 左图展示了一个简单却温暖的场景：一名残障人士正使用轮椅沿无障碍通道轻松移动。

l07.en: Meanwhile, the right chart clearly illustrates that in a certain city, from 2021 to 2025, the proportion of public places equipped with accessible pathways increased remarkably, from 56% to 85%.
l07.zh: 同时，右图清楚表明，2021 至 2025 年，某市配备无障碍通道的公共场所比例从 56% 显著上升至 85%。

l07.en: The scene and statistics above, apparently, can be associated with the special care for people with disabilities in real life.
l07.zh: 上述场景和数据显然与现实中对残障人士的特殊关爱有关。

l07.en: Then, what resulted in this phenomenon?
l07.zh: 那么，是什么导致了这一现象？

l07.en: In recent years, China has been characterized by its economic boom and prosperity, which has enabled the government to devote more financial budgets to public facilities, including accessible pathways.
l07.zh: 近年来，中国经济繁荣，使政府能够投入更多财政预算用于公共设施，包括无障碍通道。

l07.en: It is these facilities that ensure people with limited mobility to enjoy tremendous convenience and get around independently.
l07.zh: 正是这些设施让行动不便的人享受巨大便利，并能够独立出行。

l07.en: To my mind, this special care can be likened to sunshine, which can bring warmth to those in need, inspire their passion for life, and help us build a civilized society.
l07.zh: 在我看来，这种特殊关爱可以比作阳光，能给需要帮助的人带来温暖，激发他们对生活的热情，并帮助我们建设文明社会。

l07.en: In the final analysis, I deem that it is advisable for the government to build more accessible pathways in public places.
l07.zh: 归根结底，我认为政府应在公共场所建设更多无障碍通道。

l07.en: Meanwhile, society as a whole is supposed to foster a positive atmosphere to care for, love, and protect those with disabilities and the like.
l07.zh: 同时，全社会应营造积极氛围，关心、关爱并保护残障人士及其他类似群体。

l08.en: In the left drawing, there is a professional healthcare worker, imparting first aid knowledge to two youngsters.
l08.zh: 左边的图画中，一位专业医护人员正在向两名年轻人传授急救知识。

l08.en: Meanwhile, the right chart clearly illustrates that from 2021 to 2025, in a certain city, the proportion of residents aged 18 to 60 who attended first aid courses ascended significantly, from 9% to 32%.
l08.zh: 与此同时，右侧图表清晰显示，2021 年至 2025 年，某市参加急救课程的 18 至 60 岁居民比例从 9% 显著上升至 32%。

l08.en: The scene and statistics above, definitely, can be associated with a positive shift in public awareness regarding safety and health.
l08.zh: 上述场景和数据无疑与公众安全健康意识的积极转变有关。

l08.en: Undoubtedly, in recent decades, China has been characterized by its economic prosperity and technological advancement, which have enabled people to enjoy a higher quality of life and have more opportunities to acquire various kinds of knowledge, including first aid skills.
l08.zh: 毫无疑问，近几十年来中国经济繁荣、科技进步，使人们享有更高的生活质量，并有更多机会学习包括急救技能在内的各种知识。

l08.en: It is mastering basic first aid skills that enables citizens to save their own or others’ lives in emergencies, such as cardiac arrests, accidents.
l08.zh: 正是掌握基本急救技能，使市民能够在心脏骤停、事故等紧急情况下挽救自己或他人的生命。

l08.en: I am a case in point.
As a youngster, I prefer watching health education videos and TV programs, as well as attending medical lectures to acquire first aid knowledge.
l08.zh: 作为年轻人，我更愿意通过观看健康教育视频和电视节目，以及参加医学讲座来学习急救知识。

l08.en: Thanks to such knowledge, I helped save an injured man after a car accident.
l08.zh: 多亏这些知识，我曾在一场车祸后帮助救了一名受伤男子。

l08.en: In a nutshell, I am convinced that it is advisable for hospitals to offer more free training courses to people from all walks of life.
l08.zh: 总之，我相信医院应该为各行各业的人提供更多免费培训课程。

l08.en: Meanwhile, society as a whole should foster a positive atmosphere to inspire the public to learn these vital skills.
l08.zh: 同时，全社会都应营造积极氛围，鼓励公众学习这些重要技能。

l09.en: These are two simple but satirical drawings.
l09.zh: 这是两幅简单却具有讽刺意味的图画。

l09.en: In the left picture, there is a girl, sitting in front of a computer and typing so many words with no difficulty.
l09.zh: 左图中，一名女孩坐在电脑前，毫不费力地打出许多字。

l09.en: However, in the right cartoon, without the help of modern technology, the girl has great trouble in writing words on paper, with the thought in her mind: I need to look them up on my cell phone.
l09.zh: 然而，在右图中，没有现代科技的帮助，女孩在纸上写字十分困难，心里想着：我需要用手机查一查。

l09.en: Finally, several Chinese characters can be noticed below the pictures, which read that science and technology has changed people’s habits.
l09.zh: 最后，图下有几行汉字，大意是科技改变了人们的习惯。

l09.en: The fast development of science and technology, to my understanding, can be likened to a double-edged sword.
l09.zh: 在我看来，科技的快速发展可以比作一把双刃剑。

l09.en: On the one hand, numerous innovative technological products can bring us great convenience, inspire our passion for a promising life, and help us enhance work efficiency.
l09.zh: 一方面，许多创新科技产品能给我们带来极大便利，激发我们对美好生活的热情，并帮助我们提高工作效率。

l09.en: On the other hand, it is modern technology that causes a number of youngsters to lose certain basic skills in life, work, and study.
l09.zh: 另一方面，正是现代科技导致许多年轻人失去了生活、工作和学习中的某些基本技能。

l09.en: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention.
l09.zh: 这一现象尤其值得关注。

l09.en: As a college student, I deem that it is advisable for us to utilize modern technological products, but it is of no necessity to be slaves to IT products.
l09.zh: 作为大学生，我认为我们应该使用现代科技产品，但没有必要成为信息技术产品的奴隶。

l10.en: This is a simple but enlightening excerpt of an article, in which the author argues that incentive-based parenting can be effective at home for the short term, but will become a problem in the long run.
l10.zh: 这是一段简单却发人深省的文章节选，作者认为奖励式育儿在家庭中短期内可能有效，但从长远看会成为问题。

l10.en: Although I have no children, I couldn’t agree more with it.
l10.zh: 虽然我没有孩子，但我完全赞同这一观点。

l10.en: To my understanding, one’s internal motivation can be likened to the key to success.
l10.zh: 在我看来，内在动力可以比作成功的关键。

l10.en: A case in point is myself.

As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I cling to the idea that it is inner motivation that enables me to work hard each day and accumulate adequate knowledge and competence to achieve my dream.
l10.zh: 作为一名准备全国研究生入学考试的大四学生，我坚信正是内在动力让我每天努力学习，积累足够的知识和能力以实现梦想。

l10.en: However, in reality, a host of short-sighted parents may merely rely on the so-called reward system to encourage their children.
l10.zh: 然而现实中，许多目光短浅的父母可能只依靠所谓的奖励制度来鼓励孩子。

l10.en: This phenomenon is particularly worth attention for the reason that children often fail to maintain positive behaviors if the reward is unavailable.
l10.zh: 这种现象尤其值得关注，因为一旦没有奖励，孩子往往无法保持积极行为。

l10.en: That is to say, in the long term, this sort of reward system may constitute an obstacle that hinders youngsters’ growth and progress.
l10.zh: 也就是说，从长远来看，这种奖励制度可能成为阻碍年轻人成长进步的障碍。

l10.en: Accordingly, all parents should bear in mind that internal motivation cultivates interest in learning itself.
l10.zh: 因此，所有父母都应牢记，内在动力能够培养对学习本身的兴趣。

l10.en: If parents intend to see children’s sustainable growth, it is advisable for them to inspire the young’s internal motivation.
l10.zh: 如果父母希望看到孩子持续成长，就应该激发年轻人的内在动力。

a01.en: Given is a simple but enlightening excerpt of an article, which clearly illustrates the result of studies in the U.S. and the U.K.: children have lost the right to wander and thus, they turn to technology to socialize, relax and learn.
a01.zh: 这是一篇简单却发人深省的文章节选，清晰展示了美国和英国的研究结果：孩子们失去了自由闲逛的权利，因此转向科技进行社交、放松和学习。

a01.en: As a youngster, I agree with this argument.
a01.zh: 作为一名年轻人，我赞同这一观点。

a01.en: Admittedly, compared to the past years, children enjoy less space and freedom to wander, especially in cities, where traffic is busy and skyscrapers are everywhere.
a01.zh: 诚然，与过去相比，孩子们自由闲逛的空间更小、自由更少，尤其是在交通繁忙、高楼林立的城市中。

a01.en: Even in city parks, children are still followed and protected by parents.
a01.zh: 即使在城市公园里，孩子们也仍然有父母跟随和保护。

a01.en: However, as the studies show, children are fond of interacting with their peers rather than their parents.
a01.zh: 然而，正如研究所示，孩子们喜欢与同龄人互动，而不是与父母互动。

a01.en: A case in point is myself.
As a senior who is preparing for the national entrance exams for postgraduate studies, I do not prefer discussing my problems in learning with my parents or siblings.
a01.zh: 作为一名正在准备全国研究生入学考试的大四学生，我不喜欢与父母或兄弟姐妹讨论学习问题。

a01.en: Instead, I tend to release my stress by listening to music, chatting with friends or playing games on smartphones.
a01.zh: 相反，我倾向于通过听音乐、与朋友聊天或在智能手机上玩游戏来释放压力。

a01.en: Accordingly, it is advisable for parents to give children the right to wander.
a01.zh: 因此，建议父母给予孩子自由闲逛的权利。

a01.en: Meanwhile, parents are supposed to guide their kids to use technology in a rational way because some of them may be addicted to video games.
a01.zh: 同时，父母应该引导孩子理性地使用科技，因为有些孩子可能会沉迷于电子游戏。
